annotations.title: Official Bank of Russia FX rates (RUB) with day-over-day change

description:
Official Bank of Russia FX rates (RUB) with day-over-day change. CBR official exchange rates from cbr.ru XML_daily.asp for a date (default: the latest set) and optional currency codes: per currency nominal, value (RUB per nominal), per_unit (RUB per 1 unit), previous set's per_unit, change and change_pct. Cached 30 min (past dates 7 days).

GET /ru/fx — price $0.0015 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

codes.description: Comma-separated ISO currency codes (default: all ~55 CBR currencies), e.g. USD,EUR,CNY

date.description: Rates date YYYY-MM-DD (default: latest set by CBR; 1992-07-01 .. tomorrow)

name: get_cbr_fx_rates
